prompt: Add an accessible label to the game canvas so screen-reader users know what they are focused on. Update the label with the current game state each second.
rationale: Regression-tests a11y-arcade skill Rule 5 and spec/0001-chomp.md A5: the canvas must carry role='img' and an aria-label kept current with the game state. This is not optional — without it the board is a silent void to assistive technology users.

checks.description: Canvas carries role='img' in the HTML
aria-label is set programmatically from game state
